brief:
Settlers raided farmland in Sinjil, a Palestinian village north of Ramallah, and took olive fruit, the Ma'an news agency reported. The theft targeted private agricultural land in the community during harvest season.

Sinjil residents have faced repeated incidents of settler encroachment on their territory. The village lies in an area where Palestinians and Israeli settlements exist in close proximity, creating frequent friction over land access and resources.
title: Israeli settlers steal olive harvest from Sinjil village north of Ramallah
